comment: The slave CLEAR condition at luppolo3.cpp:280 tests params[CLEAR_M] rather than params[CLEAR_M + t], so the two slave CLEAR buttons are never read and the master CLEAR button clears all three tracks; the CV jacks are indexed correctly and behave as labelled. That is why the two slave buttons get a line saying they do nothing. The master track is recorded by appending to a deque while the slaves are written in place at the master's current position (luppolo3.cpp:207 to :212, :296, :297), which is what keeps them the same length. Master CLEAR fills the master loop with zeros rather than emptying it (luppolo3.cpp:194), keeping the length. The per-track outputs are written only while the master loop exists (luppolo3.cpp:337). The main outputs add the live input while any track is recording (luppolo3.cpp:328 to :332). There is no dataToJson, so nothing survives a reload.
